Arabic text: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِيْ أَكْرَمَنَا بِهٰذَا الْيَوْمِ
Translation: All praise is to Allah Who has honored us with this day
And made us among those who fulfill His covenant with us
And His pledge which He bound us to
Regarding the guardianship of those in authority of His command
And those who establish His justice
And He did not make us among those who deny
And those who reject the Day of Judgment
